title: Create New Account
description: The login page makes it hard to discover how a new account is actually created. Current behavior is split across first-admin setup and external-provider onboarding: `/admin/setup` creates the initial local admin account, and GitHub sign-in can create a user on first successful authentication when that provider is enabled. Expected behavior: the login page should explicitly explain the available account-creation paths, make first-admin setup obvious when no admin exists, and avoid implying that a normal self-serve local signup flow exists when it does not.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Expanded from code review. There is no general self-serve local signup page today: first admin creation happens through `/admin/setup`, and GitHub challenge flow creates a local user record on first successful sign-in when GitHub auth is enabled. The user-facing gap is discoverability on `/login`, not necessarily a missing account system.
